## Velha da Égua Branca (CR 21)

This wrinkled, aged woman wears a white headdress adorned with red ribbons and clutches a dagger. Her clothing and leather shoes are otherwise ragged. She sits astride a blazing white stallion bedecked with tack and harness covered in bells, jugs, and clay pots.  

**XP** 409,600  
N Medium fey (unique)  
**Init** +8; **Senses** darkvision 120 ft., low-light vision; Perception +29  


**Defense**


**AC** 39, touch 19, flat-footed 30 (+8 Dex, +1 dodge, +20 natural)  
**hp** 440 (40d6+200)  
**Fort** +20, **Ref** +30, **Will** +30  
**DR** 5/cold iron; **SR** 32  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft., fly 30 ft. (hover)  
**Melee** dagger +34/+29/+24/+19 (1d4+11/17-20)  
**Ranged** moonlight lance +28 (20d10)  
**Space** 5 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  
**Special Attacks** fear (60-ft. cone, DC 36), moonlight lance, cacophonous shout (DC 36)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 22, **Dex** 26, **Con** 20, **Int** 12, **Wis** 23, **Cha** 22  
**Base Atk** +20; **CMB** +26; **CMD** 44  
**Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Great Fortitude, Improved Critical (dagger), Improved Iron Will, Iron Will, Mounted Combat, [Point-Blank Shot](../../rules/feats/point-blank-shot.md), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md), [Weapon Focus (dagger)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Point-Blank Shot and Precise Shot are one feat, Point-Blank Shot; in their place: Weapon Focus (dagger).*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +26, Climb +27, Escape Artist +26, Fly +20, Intimidate +26, Knowledge (geography) +19, Knowledge (nature) +19, Perception +29, Ride +20, Sense Motive +16, Stealth +19  
**Languages** Common, Sylvan  


**Special Abilities**



**Cacophonous Shout (Su)** Once per day, the Velha de égua Branca can emit a devastating wailing as per the spell shout, but it deals 20d6 sonic damage (20d8 against crystalline or brittle creatures or objects) and affects a 60-ft. cone.  

**Fear (Su)** Once per day, the Velha de égua branca can use fear, as the spell, affecting a 60-foot cone-shaped spread.  

**Moonlight Lance (Su)** Three times per day, the Velha de égua branca can cast a beam of silvery light from her hand. This is a ray with a range of 60 feet that deals 20d10 damage. This damage is pure magical energy and not of a particular energy type. A target that is a shapechanger with a weakness to silvered weapons (such as a lycanthrope‘s DR/silver) who is struck must succeed on a DC 36 Fortitude save or instantly revert to its true form and be unable to use its shapechange ability for 1 minute.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any  
**Organization** pair (with the égua branca)  
**Treasure** standard (+5 dagger and other treasure)
